laya_multilingual_max_len_8192.note: no separation on English technical text; long-context arm not usable here

latency_probes_mps.note: MPS gives ~no batch throughput win (~63ms/pair flat). Published CUDA numbers (T4 33ms/q; ~1ms/decision batched) imply pool50 ~0.3-0.5s on a GPU box.

ordering.verdict: FlashRank wins all three metrics and stays the default. Laya beats RRF order on MRR/nDCG (0.583/0.627 vs 0.528/0.589) but loses to the trained cross-encoder. laya-noul ships as a measured variant only.

gate.verdict: laya noul is a clean calibrated separator on this split but the gate is not better than the incumbent (0.0/0.038 vs 0.0/0.0). Its value is threshold portability across reranker swaps; abstain_min_score_noul=0.65 is the recorded derivation.

verdict.quality: usable relevance signal (gold 0.48 vs distractor 0.13; unanswerable distractors 0.05) but NOT better than the incumbent TinyBERT cross-encoder on this set (25/26 vs 26/26 query wins, weaker margins). Zero-shot decision model vs MS-MARCO-trained reranker on English tech docs. Final ordering call: evals/splits/retrieval.jsonl qrels bench.
verdict.latency: pool-50 rerank NOT acceptable on this hardware (30-40x FlashRank). Acceptable on CUDA deploys. Top-8 gate verify 519ms.
verdict.calibrated_gate: noul is a probability (0-1 scale) vs FlashRank's uncalibrated bimodal scores; threshold portability across model swaps is the remaining real win. Adopt only if the qrels calibration harness shows equal-or-better false_answer/false_abstain.
verdict.decision: default rerank stays FlashRank (qrels confirmed). laya-noul ships as a measured variant + scale-matched gate (abstain_min_score_noul=0.65); no default swap.
